family.base: arbitrary bent Boolean sign g on even k>=8 bits
family.surgery: flip g at exactly one physical input to obtain h
family.selector: fresh d-bit block; one activation word chooses h, all other words choose g

stopping_rule.description: Reveal the fresh controls until the first mismatch with the activation word, then stop at g; if no mismatch occurs, reach h.

charges.rare_log_treatment: The k-|T| cap logarithm cancels atomwise before the Taylor bound.

nonreuse.selector_coordinates: Each fresh selector coordinate is charged once at this node.
nonreuse.terminal_packets: Each child U packet is retained once at its exact reach probability.
nonreuse.ancestor_or_descendant_credit: None is used by the theorem.

remaining_debt: No ledger is proved for two or more coherent point surgeries; cross-surgery cap interactions may accumulate.
